==English== ===Alternative forms=== * {{alt|en|strang||dialectal}} * {{alt|en|stronk||deliberate misspelling}} ===Etymology=== {{ety|en|:inh|enm:strong}} From {{inh|en|enm|strong,strang}}, from {{inh|en|ang|strang||strong}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*strang|t=severe, strict, rigorous, strong}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*strangaz||tight, strict, straight, strong}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*strengʰ-||taut, stiff, tight}}. Cognate with {{cog|sco|strang|t=strong}}, {{cog|fy|strang}}, {{m|fy|string|t=strict, harsh, severe, stern, stark, tough, strong, intense}}, {{cog|nl|streng|t=strict, severe, tight}}, dialectal {{cog|nl|strang|t=tight, strict, powerful, intense, mighty, strong}}, {{cog|de|streng|t=strict, severe, austere}}, {{cog|da|-}} and {{cog|no|streng|t=strong, hard}}, {{cog|no|strang|t=strong, harsh, bitter}}, {{cog|sv|sträng}}, {{m|sv|strang|t=severe, strict, harsh}}, {{cog|fo|-}} and {{cog|is|strangur|t=strict}}, {{cog|la|stringō|t=tighten}}.
